text:
Olivia Park: Ok new plan for this Sunday — bodegon-style brunch at La Bodega + optional 90s karaoke at 4pm nearby. low-key, BYOB or BYO-coffee. whoin? :baguette_bread::microphone:
Diego Mendez: sounds fun. are we doing a group reservation at the bodega for 12pm?
Olivia Park: thinking 12:30 to keep it weekend-mellow. i can call to hold a couple tables for ~8.
Fiona O'Neill: i can bring a portable speaker for karaoke later if people want that option. won't stay too late tho.
Harpreet Kaur: heads up i'm on call until 1pm so 12:30 is perfect. re: karaoke, i'm very much a background cheerer, not a performer. :sweat_smile:
Gabe Silva: can we do a quick poll react :baguette_bread: for brunch-only, :microphone: for karaoke after, :wave: if maybe (undecided).
Diego Mendez: :baguette_bread:
Fiona O'Neill: :microphone:
Harpreet Kaur: :baguette_bread:
Olivia Park: RSVP list so far: Olivia, Diego, Fiona, Harpreet, Gabe. feel free to bring +1 but mark it on the RSVP.
Gabe Silva: any dietary restrictions? i can ask the bodega to label gluten-free options.
Harpreet Kaur: vegan option would be great, thanks.
Olivia Park: noted i'll ask them about vegan empanadas and a GF tostada.
Diego Mendez: also quick logistics: is seating outside ok? pet-friendly?
Olivia Park: bodega has a small patio, first-come. dogs allowed outside on leash.
Fiona O'Neill: rain plan? i vote moving to The Corner Tavern if it drizzles.
Olivia Park: agreed, Corner Tavern is our backup.
Gabe Silva: can someone add this to calendar? i always forget Sunday plans.
calendar-bot: Event created "La Bodega Brunch + Optional 90s Karaoke" Sunday 12:30 PM. RSVP: https://cal.example.com/event/1999
Olivia Park: link posted please RSVP there and add +1s. i'll update if i get a table hold number. see you (and your croissants) on Sunday! :croissant:
